name: Makeblock mBot2
description: A buildable robot for learning block-based coding and Python with mBlock. Consider it for guided home learning, STEM clubs and classroom projects.
checks: Confirm the kit contents, recommended age, computer compatibility, local shipping and replacement parts with Makeblock.

name: Loona by KEYI
description: A consumer companion robot offered through KEYI's official catalogue. Compare the exact edition and its app requirements before purchase.
checks: Confirm edition, supported languages, app and account requirements, optional subscriptions, privacy settings and local warranty.

name: Unitree Go2
description: A robot dog with different configurations. Intended use, programming access and included features need to be checked for the specific version.
checks: Ask the supplier about the exact configuration, SDK access, training, safe operating space, spare batteries, delivered cost and service support.

name: Unitree G1
description: A humanoid platform with manufacturer-demonstrated movement and performance routines. Ask about supervised dancing, demonstrations and event suitability for the exact configuration.
checks: Request an exact-task demo and confirm trained operators, public-space restrictions, emergency stop, exclusion zone, transport, insurance and event support. A viral performance is not a turnkey mall deployment.

name: UBTECH Walker C1
description: A humanoid service platform advertised for reception, visitor interaction, shopping assistance and cultural performances. Discuss your venue and required tasks with UBTECH.
checks: Confirm available configurations, languages, venue survey, performance programming, operators, installation, service coverage and delivery before booking.

name: PUDU BellaBot
description: A delivery and interaction robot for restaurant and retail scenarios. Consider a venue-specific demonstration before requesting a purchase proposal.
checks: Ask about layout mapping, floors, accessibility, installation, staff training, servicing and local availability. This is a delivery robot, not a dancing humanoid.
